newsitem.title: USA: RightChoice, Mo. Blues say end BJC talks.
newsitem.headline: RightChoice, Mo. Blues say end BJC talks.

text.p: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri and its for-profit subsidairy, RightChoice Managed Care Inc, said jointly Tuesday that they have ended discussions with BJC Health System concerning a possible alliance or business combination.

"Following extensive review with the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association and BJC Health System, the boards of BCBSMo and RightChoice determined that current BCBSA rules are not sufficiently flexible to allow the creation of a vertically integrated structure that will achieve the desired benefits for members and shareholders," the organizations said.

The Missouri Blues and RightChoice boards said, "It would not be prudent to further pursue a vertical alliance or combination at this time." The two organizations should focus on "strengthening core business, resolving regulatory issues, enhancing customer service and competitiveness, and improving profitability," they said.

The boards will pursue "a policy of independence for BCBSMo and RightChoice for the foreseeable future." But, at the same time, they said, "The boards will continue to examine acquisitions, mergers, joint ventures and other business opportunities when they arise."
RightChoice was spun off from the Missouri Blues as a for-profit unit in 1994.
